title: Affine chart coherence on original elements
statement: Let $A$ be a commutative local ring and let $C$ be its maximal-ideal adic completion [def-weil-pbc-adic-completion], with structural homomorphism $\varphi:A\to C$. Let $U\subseteq\operatorname{Spec}A$ be open, $q:Y\to U$ and $s:E\to\operatorname{Spec}C$ morphisms of schemes, and $D$ a supplied overlap identification [def-sbc-punctured-completion-matching-sections]. Let $t\in\mathbb N$, $f:\operatorname{Fin}(t)\to A$, and suppose $D(f_i)\subseteq U$ and $V_i=(q\circ U.\iota)^{-1}D(f_i)$ is affine for every $i$. Put $O=Y\times_U(\operatorname{Spec}C|_U)$ and $p:O\to Y$ its projection. Suppose $T$ is any system of transition and section equivalences satisfying the scalar and restriction formulas [lem-sbc-punctured-completion-affine-chart-transitions], with no coherence hypothesis. The two square paths in [def-weil-pbc-formal-glueing-data], using $T$'s transition maps and the canonical comparison and swap, agree on $(m'/1)/1$ for every $m'\in M'$. The two cocycle paths agree on $(m/1)/1$ for every $m\in M_i$ and every triple $i,j,k$. This statement concerns only images of original elements, not arbitrary fractions, and constructs no modules or maps.

proof.text: Equip section rings with the structural A-module action and restriction maps with their linear structures. The double intersection V_i intersect V_j is the principal open defined by f_i in the affine V_j, and the triple intersection is its principal open defined by f_k. Use IsAffineOpen.isLocalization_of_eq_basicOpen and IsLocalizedModule.restrictScalars_powers to identify the triple-section restriction as module localization. The scalar formula b_scalar turns b_ij into a linear equivalence. Transport the localization structure across b_ij and use IsLocalizedModule.iso, whose formula iso_mk_one identifies x/1 with the restriction of b_ij(x). These are actual constructions and proved private helpers, with no postponed statement.

Paste the pullback defining the overlap O with isPullback_morphismRestrict to view O as the pullback over Spec A of Y and Spec C. Mathlib isIso_pushoutSection_of_isAffineOpen identifies sections on the completed double intersection with the pushout of its affine section ring and C over A. Transport the two global-section rings along GammaSpecIso; then compare this pushout with CommRingCat.isPushout_tensorProduct. The pushout inclusion formulas and multiplicativity give the pure-tensor formula z tensor x maps to chartScalarMap(hC)(z) times p.app(x). Tensor b_ij, made A-linear by b_scalar, to obtain an injective additive equivalence Q on the target of each square path. This construction does not use flatness or choose an object from unproved existence.

Use tensor induction to identify Q composed with compare, and Q composed with extendMapR(alpha_overlap) and compare, with restrictions of d_j and d_i respectively. On pure tensors compare_tmul and extendMapR_tmul reduce to b_right and b_left. The hypotheses d_chart and d_scalar, naturality of the projection on sections, and restriction of structural scalars prove the required equations; zero and sum cases follow from additivity. Expand both square paths on (m/1)/1 using localMap and swap formulas. Under injective Q, d_prime makes both sides the same restriction of D.toCompleted.appTop(e(m)); presheaf functoriality finishes.

For the cocycle fix a common triple open W and use six localized section equivalences, one for each of the two localization orders on each chart. On original chart elements, b_left, b_right, and restriction functoriality identify each localized transition and each swap with the corresponding change of section equivalences. Two applications of IsLocalizedModule.ext extend these identities to all fractions; scalar units are obtained by transporting the localized module structure across the equivalences. Applying the injective final section equivalence reduces both cocycle paths to the same initial section equivalence. This proves equality of the full cocycle maps and hence their values on original elements. Empty principal opens and repeated chart indices are included by the same universal properties.

theorem affine_chart_transition_generator_coherence
    {A : Type u} [CommRing A] [IsLocalRing A]
    {U : (Spec (.of A)).Opens}
    {Y : Scheme.{u}} {q : Y ⟶ U.toScheme}
    {E : Scheme.{u}} {s : E ⟶ Spec
      (.of (AdicCompletion (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal A) A))}
    (D : CompletionGluingData A U q E s) (t : ℕ) (f : Fin t → A)
    (hf : ∀ i, PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen (f i) ≤ U)
    (hV : ∀ i, IsAffineOpen ((q ≫ U.ι) ⁻¹ᵁ PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen (f i)))
    (T : AffineChartTransitions D t f) :
    (∀ i j : Fin t,
      ∀ m : T.F.M',
      T.F.squareLeft i j (LocalizedModule.mk (LocalizedModule.mk m 1) 1) =
        T.F.squareRight i j (LocalizedModule.mk (LocalizedModule.mk m 1) 1)) ∧
    (∀ i j k : Fin t,
      ∀ m : FormalGlueing.piece (f i) (T.F.M i),
      T.F.cocycleLeft i j k (LocalizedModule.mk (LocalizedModule.mk m 1) 1) =
        T.F.cocycleRight i j k (LocalizedModule.mk (LocalizedModule.mk m 1) 1))
